title: Glucose Plugin Reading doesn't match with graph (Phone)
symptom: When using Calibration Plugin Datricsae with MiaoMiao/Bubble + Libre, the last reading (numeric value) doesn't match with the value drawn in the graphic. For example, the Datricsae reading is 147 but the graph dot shows 151.6.
evidence_quote: When using Calibration Plugin **Datricsae** with MiaoMiao/Bubble + Libre, the last reading (numeric value) doesn't match with the value drawn in the graphic.
